correctness.rationale: The exact language condition is that both constant m-runs occur; length n-1 legal prefix/suffix force opposite terminal m-runs with alternating bounded interior runs. This is a unique decomposition and gives the claimed GF for all n. Its dominant radius solves sum_{j=1}^{m-1}rho^j=1, equal to renewal radius of the overlap bounded-run shift. Standard primitive finite-type state diagrams yield component Perron root lambda_m and unique Parry maximal measures, and ergodicity on two invariant components yields exactly two. The identity 2-lambda_r=lambda_r^{-r} proves the claimed delta_m asymptotic. Checked the m=2 boundary and 64 exhaustive small coefficient comparisons from CHECKER.py.

value.rationale: The complementary-run binary union is a canonical symbolic model of competing opposite local exclusions. Its infinite minimal obstruction language has an all-m rational count whose exponential growth equals the exact entropy of the physical overlap of the two maximizing phases, while each phase has larger entropy. The explicit two-phase Parry decomposition with a gap asymptotic 2^{-m-1} provides a sharp near-equality family illustrating that arbitrarily small positive forbidden-word entropy gaps permit persistent multiple maximal measures. This combines a structural invariant identity with phase behavior and a natural limit, not a stand-alone arbitrary table or generic rationality deduction.
